reviews.title: Ads ruin the game.
reviews.text: I played about 50 games and won about 30, but at some point they started introducing ads after every match. The opponents are bots, for one, and second, you’ll be watching ads nonstop unless you pay $10. Uninstalling, this is not jeopardy. This is just a trivia crack re-skin. You had a good IP with the jeopardy logo, and game, but squandered it horribly. You can figure out why people play and leave instantly… it’s because you’re running a racket. Game has potential, but you folks are ruining it.

reviews.text:
Hi there,

WOW. We simply cannot hope for a Jeopardy! World Tour experience as uplifting as this. Thank you for sharing your family's impactful experience with us; experiences like this are why we love what we do!

Rest assured I will pass your feedback about categories along to the entire team. If you ever come across incorrect content feel free to let us know by tapping your profile picture and scrolling down to "Contact Us". This way our team is notified and can begin the process of fixing any errors!

We look forward to continuing being a small part of your weekly family gatherings. Happy playing!
